body: I would move column number check here and use `column_to_translation` instead of raw column size, since CSV with 2 columns is invalid if one of it is comment, ?plural or ?context.
Probably should have a warning if multiple `?pluralrule` are present.

```suggestion
			ERR_CONTINUE_MSG(locale.is_empty(), vformat("Error importing CSV translation: Invalid locale format '%s', should be 'language_Script_COUNTRY_VARIANT@extra'. This column will be ignored.", line[i]));
```
I'd say
